name: Raising Spirits

angles.text: As a shaman, you see the Horde's revived traditions brought to bear against Gor'mul's despondency. Tor'gan calls on animal spirits to rekindle his will to live.
As an orc, you know internment and the loss of old ways have burdened veterans like Gor'mul with despair and lethargy. Some struggle to embrace Thrall's new Horde.
As a member of the Horde, you see comrades at remote outposts like Hammerfall caring for despondent brothers-in-arms.

faq.answer: Tor'gan is a troll shaman stationed at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. He hopes to help Gor'mul with an amulet made through the Horde's newly rediscovered shamanic traditions.
Gor'mul is an orc at Hammerfall, sunk in despondency and lethargy. Tales of Orgrimmar and Warchief Thrall have not lifted his spirits.
faq.q: Who is Gor'mul and why does he need cheering up?

faq.answer: Tor'gan uses the eyes of Highland Striders and Highland Thrashers to make a shamanic amulet. He hopes their spirits will lend Gor'mul strength and tenacity, and rekindle his fighting spirit.
faq.q: Why does Tor'gan need highland raptor eyes?

faq.answer: Hammerfall is the Horde outpost in the Arathi Highlands. It is named for former Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer and is a fortified haven for orcs remaining in the Eastern Kingdoms.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

faq.answer: Orcs lost their spiritual bond with the elements and ancestor spirits during demonic corruption and internment. Under Warchief Thrall, the Horde has reclaimed the ancient shamanic path, guided by spiritual harmony rather than fel magic.
faq.q: What is the newly found shamanistic magic mentioned by Tor'gan?

aliases: what stories did they tell gormul
faq.answer: Gor'mul's companions told him of Orgrimmar, the new capital across the sea in Kalimdor, and of Warchief Thrall wielding Orgrim Doomhammer's armor and legendary warhammer.
faq.q: What stories failed to cheer up Gor'mul?

sections.body: At Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands, Gor'mul has fallen into deep melancholy. His companions have told him of Kalimdor, the mighty city of Orgrimmar, and Warchief Thrall's leadership. Yet none of these tales has eased his gloom or given him hope.
sections.title: A Heavy Heart in Hammerfall

sections.body: Tor'gan turns to the Horde's revived spiritual traditions to help Gor'mul. He gathers the eyes of highland raptors roaming Arathi and makes an amulet blessed with their spirits. Through this rite, he hopes the predators' vital force will awaken Gor'mul's will to live.
sections.title: Spirits of the Wild

summary: Tor'gan seeks a way to lift Gor'mul's spirits at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Tales of Orgrimmar and Warchief Thrall have brought no comfort, so Tor'gan turns to the Horde's newly rediscovered shamanic traditions.
